questions.text: Describe an art gallery or exhibition you have visited.
questions.say: Thank you. Now, in Part 2, I'm going to give you a topic, and I'd like you to talk about it for one to two minutes. Before you talk, you'll have one minute to think about what you're going to say. You can make some notes if you wish. Here is your topic. Describe an art gallery or exhibition you have visited. You should say: where it was; what you saw there; who you went with; and explain what you thought of this gallery or exhibition.

questions.text: Do you often visit galleries or exhibitions?
questions.say: Thank you. Do you often visit galleries or exhibitions?

questions.text: Why do some people pay a lot of money for works of art?
questions.say: Thank you. We've been talking about an art gallery or exhibition you have visited, and I'd like to discuss with you some more general questions related to this. Let's consider first of all art. Why do some people pay a lot of money for works of art?

questions.text: Do you think modern art is as valuable as traditional art?

questions.text: Why do some people say they don't understand art?

questions.text: Should art be a compulsory subject at school?
questions.say: Now let's talk about art education. Should art be a compulsory subject at school?
